title: Novelty constructs and levels
required_subareas: disruption indices as an adjacent consequence construct
psychological stimulus novelty and Bayesian surprise as adjacent constructs
question: Which definitions distinguish first occurrence, uncommonness, meaningful departure, perceived newness and creative quality at person, process, product and collective levels?
required_adverse_case: New wording, rarity, nonsense, later influence and adoption must not silently substitute for the target construct.
deliverable: Construct crosswalk with operational definitions, admissible interpretations and explicit prohibited substitutions. Include an English–Chinese construct glossary, with L49 coordinating terminology encountered in source discovery.
english_terms: novelty originality atypicality creativity construct measurement

title: Reference universes and time
required_subareas: bounded database reference universes (chess and patent families), with inclusion, version and missingness audits
model-generated comparator and expectation distributions, including sampling and producer/evaluator dependence
question: How should comparison sets and information available at assessment time be specified, sampled and documented?
required_adverse_case: Missing predecessors, changing corpus density, self matches, future model knowledge and unavailable reference sets.
deliverable: Reference-universe contract and sensitivity requirements covering new to self, group, firm, market, field and recorded history.
english_terms: novelty reference set comparator corpus temporal information set

title: Evaluators and perceived novelty
required_subareas: LLM-simulated rater panels as proxies for human judgment
question: Whose judgment is the target, and how do expertise, familiarity, culture and incentives change perceived novelty?
required_adverse_case: Agreement with one rater population does not establish universal validity; disagreement need not be random noise.
deliverable: Evaluator sampling and exposure framework with separate novelty, usefulness, feasibility, coherence and liking labels.
english_terms: perceived novelty expert familiarity evaluation disagreement

title: Units aggregation and meaningful recombination
question: How do component-level differences combine into whole-item novelty and collective diversity, and when is a combination meaningfully new?
required_adverse_case: Maximum versus mean score, many trivial differences, quantity confounds and unusual but incoherent recombinations.
deliverable: Aggregation crosswalk and justified metric-specific invariance or monotonicity expectations.
english_terms: novelty recombination aggregation individual collective diversity

title: New ventures and entrepreneurial opportunities
required_subareas: app stores, product listings and startup databases
question: How are opportunity and venture novelty measured relative to customers, geography, competitors and markets?
required_adverse_case: Venture age, founder novelty claims, polished pitches, funding and survival are not direct novelty measures.
deliverable: Venture measurement card set and comparator guide distinguishing market newness from substantive business novelty.
english_terms: new venture entrepreneurial opportunity market newness pitch novelty

title: Business models and strategic configurations
question: Can methods identify new configurations of activities, value creation and capture instead of merely unfamiliar terminology?
required_adverse_case: Fashionable vocabulary, category relabeling, identical activity systems described differently and performance halo.
deliverable: Component and relational scoring comparison with business-model and strategic-distinctiveness transfer limits.
english_terms: business model novelty strategic distinctiveness activity system

title: Organizational processes and forms
question: How do measures distinguish novel processes or structures from the local adoption of established practices?
required_adverse_case: New to an organization is not necessarily new to an industry; efficiency gains do not establish novelty.
deliverable: Process and organization protocol using ordered actions, roles and mechanisms alongside text baselines.
english_terms: organizational innovation management practice process novelty

title: Employee and team ideas
question: How are employee and team ideas scored within organizational knowledge and constraints?
required_adverse_case: Status, authorship, manager preferences, repeated team ideas and idea-count inflation.
deliverable: Internal-idea assessment design with individual versus team attribution and evaluator-exposure controls.
english_terms: employee idea novelty team creativity internal crowdsourcing

title: Products and functional concepts
question: Which novelty measures distinguish new functions, uses and combinations from cosmetic or descriptive changes?
required_adverse_case: Purchase intent, usefulness, technical sophistication and unusual language can contaminate novelty ratings.
deliverable: Product protocol separating feature, function, category and market-reference dimensions.
english_terms: product concept novelty new product originality functional features

title: Services and experiences
question: Where does novelty reside in a service: outcome, interaction, delivery system or experience?
required_adverse_case: Text descriptions omit enacted experience; bundling and context changes may be mistaken for entirely new services.
deliverable: Service-specific decomposition, comparators and evidence on customer versus provider judgments.
english_terms: service innovation novelty customer experience measurement

title: Crowdsourcing and innovation contests
question: How should crowd submissions be compared with one another and with external prior solutions?
required_adverse_case: Within-contest uniqueness, submission order, idea copying, popularity voting and endogenous reference pools.
deliverable: Contest assessment protocol reporting submission-pool and external-reference scores separately.
english_terms: crowdsourcing idea contest novelty assessment reference frame

title: Customer and user innovation
question: How can methods recognize user-discovered needs and solutions in situated language and experience?
required_adverse_case: Expert jargon mismatch, minority needs, familiarity bias and downstream commercial adoption as a proxy.
deliverable: User-innovation measurement and annotation design with community-specific reference sets.
english_terms: user innovation lead user customer ideas originality

title: Marketing advertising and brands
required_subareas: brand and product names, trademarks (cross-ref L53)
question: How do methods separate original messages or positioning from stylistic distinctiveness and persuasive appeal?
required_adverse_case: Attention, liking, fluency, provocation, brand reputation and sales as substitute labels.
deliverable: Marketing comparison table with content, execution and audience novelty scored separately.
english_terms: advertising originality brand positioning novelty creativity evaluation

title: Film television and interactive narratives
question: Can an LLM distinguish new plot relations, causal structure and mechanics from changes in names, setting or synopsis wording?
required_adverse_case: Synopses omit execution; franchise leakage, genre density and shared motifs can distort comparisons.
deliverable: Narrative protocol with text-role limits and a dedicated film-synopsis worked design.
english_terms: film narrative plot novelty story originality game narrative

title: Literature writing and verbal creation
question: How do conceptual, narrative, linguistic and stylistic originality differ in short and long writing?
required_adverse_case: Rare vocabulary, incoherence, imitation, length, canonical-author memorization and stylistic prestige.
deliverable: Writing task map with comparison units and criteria for meaningful rather than merely lexical departure.
english_terms: creative writing originality poetry humor metaphor novelty evaluation

title: Music sound and performance
question: What can language descriptions capture about musical or performance novelty, and what requires audio or movement representation?
required_adverse_case: Lyric novelty cannot validate sonic novelty; descriptions may erase timing, expression and execution.
deliverable: Modality comparison and transfer boundaries for lyric, semantic, acoustic and performance measures.
english_terms: music novelty melodic originality lyrics performance creativity

title: Visual art and visual communication
question: How should concept, composition, style and execution be assessed using images, captions or multimodal models?
required_adverse_case: Caption bottlenecks, style imitation, image artifacts, aesthetic value and platform popularity.
deliverable: Visual-art protocol distinguishing artifact observation from language-mediated judgments.
english_terms: visual art content visual novelty multimodal evaluation

title: Design fashion and built environments
question: How do novelty judgments reflect form, material, function, cultural convention and situated use?
required_adverse_case: Photographic presentation, local fashion cycles, verbal descriptions and functionality can change judgments independently.
deliverable: Design-domain comparison with explicit modality and cultural-reference requirements for every subarea.
english_terms: design novelty fashion architecture originality aesthetic function

title: Research questions hypotheses and theories
required_subareas: AI-generated research ideas evaluated by expert panels (cross-ref L55)
question: How can systems assess whether a proposed question or explanation adds something substantive to existing knowledge?
required_adverse_case: Plausible nonsense, field jargon, vague scope, hidden antecedents and importance or feasibility halo.
deliverable: Question and theory assessment framework with claim scope and expert-reference requirements.
english_terms: scientific idea research question hypothesis theory novelty assessment

title: Research methods and study designs
question: How is methodological novelty separated from new applications, parameter changes and benchmark performance?
required_adverse_case: Renamed established methods, missing baselines, inaccessible supplements and improvement without new mechanism.
deliverable: Method-contribution protocol using component and relational comparisons with prior methods.
english_terms: methodological novelty research design new method evaluation

title: Findings claims and scholarly arguments
required_subareas: mathematical conjectures and formal proofs (library duplicates)
question: What counts as a new finding, proof or interpretation, and how can contribution claims be checked against prior work?
required_adverse_case: Novel wording, citation omission, negative-result undervaluation, truth versus novelty and priority claims.
deliverable: Claim-level contribution map distinguishing replication, extension, contradiction and new evidence.
english_terms: scientific contribution claim novelty replication proof originality

title: Disciplinary differences and knowledge recombination
question: Which novelty criteria transfer across disciplines, and when are uncommon knowledge combinations meaningful?
required_adverse_case: Citation practices, field size, rarity of pairs, disciplinary prestige and treating all science as NLP benchmarks.
deliverable: Discipline-stratified evidence map and null-model comparison including concrete within-field and cross-field cases.
english_terms: scientific novelty disciplines recombination atypical combinations

title: Patents and technical prior art
required_subareas: official examination criteria as constructs (cross-ref L53)
question: How do research measures of technical novelty compare texts, claims and mechanisms against earlier disclosures?
required_adverse_case: Boilerplate, translation, patent families, claim amendments and confusing a research score with a legal patentability determination.
deliverable: Technical prior-art measure atlas with dates, claim granularity and explicit boundaries from legal judgment.
english_terms: patent text novelty claim prior art semantic measurement

title: Engineering and functional design
question: Can LLM-assisted functional decomposition distinguish new working principles and configurations from superficial variants?
required_adverse_case: Unworkable designs, omitted constraints, functional equivalence and reference-frequency dependence.
deliverable: Engineering metric map including novelty, variety, quality and quantity as separate outputs.
english_terms: engineering design ideation novelty functional principle metric

title: Software algorithms and digital artifacts
question: How can novelty be assessed at problem, algorithm, architecture and behavior levels rather than token-level code difference?
required_adverse_case: Refactoring, obfuscation, library reuse, memorized code, correctness and speed as novelty substitutes.
deliverable: Software novelty protocol distinguishing semantic equivalence, new combinations and new capabilities.
english_terms: software algorithm novelty code semantic originality architecture

title: Materials molecules and applied discovery
question: What measurement bridges connect language-based proposal assessment to structural or functional novelty in applied discovery?
required_adverse_case: Chemical uniqueness, synthesizability, efficacy and model confidence are different targets; string difference can be misleading.
deliverable: Bridge map with explicit representation, known-entity corpus and domain validation requirements; no experimental or medical guidance.
english_terms: molecular materials novelty language model discovery evaluation

title: Education learning and student work
question: How can novelty relative to a learner or peer group be measured without mistaking it for historical originality?
required_adverse_case: Age, curriculum exposure, language proficiency, assistance disclosure and grading-quality confounds.
deliverable: Education measurement guide with developmental and classroom-reference limits and separate originality and attainment criteria.
english_terms: student creativity originality novelty assessment education

title: Divergent thinking and creative problem solving
question: Which measures of response originality and semantic distance are validated for specific tasks and populations?
required_adverse_case: Fluency, response length, prompt repetition, invalid answers and transfer from brief tasks to real-world products.
deliverable: Task-by-population scorer atlas with human-label definitions and explicit external-validity limits.
english_terms: divergent thinking alternate uses semantic distance creativity validity

title: Public policy institutions and legal reasoning
question: How do measures separate new policy mechanisms or arguments from diffusion, local adaptation and changed drafting?
required_adverse_case: New to a jurisdiction, legal validity, political ambition, effectiveness and textual amendments are distinct.
deliverable: Policy and institutional novelty framework with an adjacent legal-argument cell and jurisdiction/time comparators.
english_terms: policy innovation novelty institutional design legal argument originality

title: Social community and sustainability innovation
question: How can measures capture contextual and community-defined departures with unevenly documented prior practice?
required_adverse_case: Documentation bias, Western reference corpora, relabeling traditional knowledge and impact as originality.
deliverable: Context-sensitive protocol with local knowledge, participation and evidence-coverage requirements.
english_terms: social innovation community novelty sustainability grassroots

title: News disclosure and information arrival
required_subareas: year-over-year disclosure change and boilerplate measures
question: How is new information relative to an existing information set measured, and where does it differ from creative novelty?
required_adverse_case: Repetition, paraphrase, timeliness, price surprise, boilerplate and changed sentiment.
deliverable: Adjacent-measure map identifying useful antecedents and prohibited transfer to historical originality.
english_terms: information novelty news disclosure redundancy text

title: Dialogue search and knowledge contributions
question: How are incremental information contributions and redundancy assessed relative to a conversation or selected set?
required_adverse_case: Answer usefulness, relevance, serendipity and set coverage do not by themselves establish original ideas.
deliverable: Incremental-contribution metric map and justified links to idea-level novelty.
english_terms: dialogue novelty knowledge contribution search summarization redundancy

title: Human AI and collective novelty
required_subareas: LLM-sampled reference distributions and common generator/evaluator dependence
question: How do individual novelty, collective diversity and the best idea change with production setting, curation and output quantity?
required_adverse_case: Shared model ancestry, repeated sampling, selection of best outputs, homogenization and treating outputs as independent.
deliverable: Production-setting and aggregation framework applied across all domain missions, with dependence-aware comparison designs.
english_terms: human AI collective creativity novelty diversity homogenization

title: Lexical and geometric baselines
question: What do lexical and embedding-distance baselines estimate, and how sensitive are they to representation and comparator choice?
required_adverse_case: Synonyms, polysemy, anisotropy, hubness, normalization and converting similarity into novelty without a construct argument.
deliverable: Formula and parameter atlas separating mean, nearest, kth-neighbor and centroid measures. Contribute mechanism ancestry and dated derivation links to the shared measure genealogy; L50 owns the integrated genealogy.
english_terms: text novelty lexical semantic distance embedding baseline

title: Density rarity and recombination
required_subareas: neutral and drift null models from cultural evolution
question: When do density, rarity and recombination scores detect meaningful departure rather than sampling artifacts?
required_adverse_case: Low-frequency instability, null-model choices, marginal frequencies and empty reference pools.
deliverable: Null-model and support-threshold comparison with explicit scoring units and reference-population assumptions.
english_terms: novelty density outlier rarity recombination null model

title: Surprise likelihood and information
required_subareas: comparator or expectation generation and the distinction between model likelihood and historical originality
question: How do language-model probability and information measures relate to novelty under specified knowledge and time boundaries?
required_adverse_case: Tokenization, nonsensical rare sequences, memorization, training leakage and unavailable likelihood interfaces.
deliverable: Information-measure map separating model surprise, factual newness and substantive originality.
english_terms: language model surprisal likelihood compression novelty

title: Concept claim event and relational representations
question: Does LLM extraction of structured units preserve the features on which domain experts base novelty judgments?
required_adverse_case: Extraction hallucinations, missed relations, ontology bias and equivalent structures with different wording.
deliverable: Structured-representation pipeline and evidence separating extraction error from comparison error.
english_terms: LLM concept claim event graph novelty representation

title: Multimodal and description-based measurement
required_subareas: generative-model fidelity, diversity and authenticity metrics
question: When can text descriptions validly stand in for artifacts, and what extra evidence do multimodal systems provide?
required_adverse_case: Description bottlenecks, missing form and execution, prompt-induced content and cross-modal metric mismatch.
deliverable: Modality-by-construct bridge matrix with direct and indirect observation clearly distinguished.
english_terms: multimodal novelty assessment caption description validity

title: Direct rubric judgments
question: Which rubric designs let LLMs judge novelty separately from quality and explain the comparison standard?
required_adverse_case: Halo, verbosity, style, flattering explanations, scale compression and unsupported self-confidence.
deliverable: Rubric catalog with exact prompts, versions, anchors and calibration evidence; no universal preferred model. Maintain a machine-readable prompt and rubric registry with model/version, exact prompt or permitted locator, scoring anchors, task, license/rights, and validation links.
english_terms: LLM judge novelty originality rubric calibration

title: Comparative and ranking judgments
question: When are comparative judgments more reliable or interpretable than absolute scores for novelty?
required_adverse_case: Position bias, intransitive rankings, comparator-set effects, ties and converting preferences to interval scores.
deliverable: Comparison and aggregation protocols with rank uncertainty and domain-specific selection criteria.
english_terms: pairwise LLM novelty ranking position bias

title: Retrieval grounded prior comparison
question: How can retrieval-assisted judges establish a stated novelty judgment against traceable prior examples?
required_adverse_case: Failed retrieval creates false novelty; authoritative-looking citations may not support the judgment.
deliverable: Retrieval-versus-assessor error decomposition, reference-corpus audit and evidence-linked output specification.
english_terms: retrieval augmented novelty assessment prior art recall

title: Decomposed contribution verification
question: Can decomposing a candidate into claims or functions make judgments inspectable and robust to paraphrase?
required_adverse_case: Decomposition omissions, false entailment, invalid analogy and rationalizations that do not demonstrate novelty.
deliverable: Contribution comparison protocol with cited antecedents, residual differences and explicit unknowns.
english_terms: claim level novelty contribution entailment prior work

title: Trained ensembles and human assisted evaluators
question: When do trained or multiple judges improve assessment, and what human calibration remains necessary?
required_adverse_case: Correlated judges, same-family self-preference, synthetic-label circularity, tuning leakage and selection bias.
deliverable: Architecture comparison with provenance, cost, dependence and calibration requirements; model training remains out of execution scope. Maintain a tools and scoring-platform registry with version, official documentation, reported task, access and license conditions, validation references and discontinuation status; no service execution is authorized.
english_terms: novelty trained evaluator ensemble human AI calibration

title: Human criteria and benchmark validity
question: What makes a benchmark or human criterion appropriate for each novelty target and deployment population?
required_adverse_case: Citation counts, accepted-paper labels, popularity or judge consensus cannot automatically supply ground truth.
deliverable: Benchmark audit and criterion-selection guide including disagreement models and label dependence.
english_terms: novelty benchmark human validation criterion reliability

title: Discriminant and adversarial validity
required_subareas: hidden-prompt manipulation of AI reviewers (2025 reports)
question: Does a score respond to meaningful changes while resisting irrelevant changes and manipulative submissions?
required_adverse_case: Prompt injection inside evaluated text, prestige cues, verbosity, incoherence and metrics rewarded for lexical rarity.
deliverable: Construct-specific perturbation battery with expected direction justified for each measure rather than imposed globally.
english_terms: novelty metric validity paraphrase adversarial style bias

title: Transport and temporal integrity
question: What evidence supports transfer across domains, audiences, languages, time and model versions?
required_adverse_case: Translation is not invariance; a later-trained model may know future outcomes despite a historical retrieval cutoff.
deliverable: Transport matrix, contamination audit and version-monitoring design with English and Chinese mandatory checks. Maintain an evaluator-model knowledge-cutoff register: provider/model/version, disclosed cutoff and its official source, observation date, disclosure status, evidence of contamination and uncertainty. An undisclosed cutoff remains unknown.
english_terms: novelty measurement invariance domain transfer multilingual contamination

title: Uncertainty calibration and decision use
question: How should uncertainty and the cost of false novelty versus missed novelty govern screening and research decisions?
required_adverse_case: Uncalibrated verbal confidence, repeated runs treated as independent and aggregate correlations hiding threshold errors.
deliverable: Decision and abstention specification with empirical calibration requirements and realistic reporting of unavailable costs.
english_terms: novelty scoring uncertainty calibration abstention decision

title: Measurement error and downstream inference
question: What happens when novelty scores enter substantive empirical analysis or determine which ideas receive review?
required_adverse_case: Outcome-informed metric selection, circular validation, shared-source errors and assuming all errors attenuate effects.
deliverable: Inference-use guide with sensitivity and error-propagation plans; no regressions on focal data.
english_terms: text measurement error novelty generated regressor inference

title: Coverage and disconnected literature recovery
required_subareas: official and standards sources route (OECD, WIPO, EPO, USPTO, FDA, ISO, Eurostat)
other-language probe list (German, French, Japanese, Korean, Spanish creativity-research traditions) with named minimal queries
question: Which domain-method families or source routes remain absent after merging all mission discoveries?
required_adverse_case: Counting imported work as new, repeated near-identical queries, inaccessible studies as empty cells and prestige-driven omission.
deliverable: Coverage summary with unresolved evidence gaps, bilingual terminology, source kinds, official-document versions and additional-language search probes.
english_terms: novelty measurement review validation gaps negative results

title: Method selection and evidence synthesis
question: Which approaches are supported for each target and which remain exploratory, unsuitable or unknown?
required_adverse_case: A global leaderboard, cross-task correlation comparisons and narrative consensus without independent support.
deliverable: Use-case decision matrix and method atlas drawn only from independently admitted current claims. Include a measure genealogy with predecessor/derived measure IDs, dated versions, inherited components and changed validation scope.
english_terms: novelty methods comparison validity evidence synthesis

title: Domain measurement protocols
required_subareas: fully developed walkthroughs for patents, divergent thinking and AI-generated research ideas
question: What concrete workflow should a researcher or evaluator use for each covered application, and when should it abstain?
required_adverse_case: One generic prompt relabeled for every domain or borrowing validation from an unrelated task.
deliverable: One protocol card per application cell with comparator, inputs, rubric, method alternatives, uncertainty and validation gaps. Add fully developed patent, divergent-thinking and AI-generated-research-idea walkthroughs. Each protocol includes relevant official-definition boundaries and a fairness audit where screening is proposed.
english_terms: novelty measurement protocol domain validation rubric

title: Prospective validation and empirical follow up
question: What future empirical study could distinguish promising measurement approaches and test cross-domain transfer?
required_adverse_case: Invented sample sizes, post hoc metric choice, contaminated splits and treating a design as executed evidence.
deliverable: Preregistration-style validation package, prioritization and data/compute requirements for a separately launched empirical stage. Deliver a machine-readable dataset and benchmark registry: name/version, task, object and reference universe, labels, rater population, size and denominator, official access route, separately verified license, availability, contamination and dependence risks, and source locators. Unknown fields remain explicit; do not acquire datasets.
english_terms: novelty benchmark validation preregistration design

title: Legal regulatory and standards definitions of novelty and originality
required_subareas: innovation survey and statistical manual definitions (Oslo Frascati CIS)
distinguish official administrative categories, substantive novelty constructs, approval status and clinical or commercial outcomes
question: Which official, legal and standards definitions of novelty, originality and innovativeness exist, how do they fix object, comparator, time and evaluator, and how do they map onto research constructs and scores?
required_adverse_case: A research score is never a legal determination; new-to-firm survey answers are self-reports with incentives; statutory definitions change by jurisdiction and date. FDA novel-drug listings, NME/NCE classifications, first-in-class assessments and Breakthrough designations are distinct categories; do not treat them as interchangeable novelty scores. Pin the issuing authority, jurisdiction, legal regime (including US AIA/pre-AIA), version and effective date. Treat non-obviousness, copyright originality and trademark distinctiveness as related but different constructs.
deliverable: Official-definition crosswalk with jurisdiction and date, mapped to the L01 construct crosswalk and consumed by every L51 protocol card. Include historical/current version relationships and explicit unmappable categories; no claim that official definitions are uniformly more precise or commensurable.
english_terms: patent novelty anticipation obviousness inventive step copyright originality trademark distinctiveness new-to-market Oslo Manual

title: Peer review grant panels and institutional evaluation of scientific novelty
required_subareas: review form novelty fields and public review corpora
question: How do reviewers, panels and funders judge novelty, what do their recorded scores and texts actually measure, and under what conditions can they serve as criteria for automated assessment?
required_adverse_case: Review scores encode risk aversion, negativity bias, prestige and workload; accepted-paper labels are selection outcomes; reviewer text can be manipulated by hidden prompts.
deliverable: Review-criterion audit and label-validity guide for using review data as novelty criteria, with disagreement models.
english_terms: peer review novelty score grant panel evaluation bias reviewer agreement

title: Autonomous discovery systems and generative-model novelty claims
required_subareas: AI generated research ideas and papers
built-in novelty checks and self assessment
question: How do autonomous generation and discovery systems define, check and claim novelty for their outputs, and what independent evidence supports or contradicts those claims?
required_adverse_case: Novel defined relative to one training set or benchmark; self-assessment by the producing model family; paraphrased borrowing that passes retrieval checks; press-release claims without demonstrated function.
deliverable: Claim-audit framework for machine-generated artifacts with producer/assessor separation and a catalogue of in-system novelty checks.
english_terms: AI scientist research idea generation novelty check program search discovery benchmark novelty

title: Training-corpus overlap memorization and authenticity measures
required_subareas: n-gram and span attribution at web scale
code clone types and semantic equivalence
training-set novelty fractions in generative benchmarks
question: What do overlap, memorization and authenticity measures estimate, against which corpora, and when can they stand in for novelty relative to a domain reference?
required_adverse_case: Overlap with the web is not overlap with the model's training data; paraphrase evades string matching; low overlap is not meaningful novelty; corpus coverage limits every claim. Separate sample overlap with an observed corpus, inference about hidden training membership, memorization, statistical authenticity and substantive contribution. MF14 is a distinct comparator/access family but may share mechanisms with MF01–MF07.
deliverable: MF14 formula and corpus atlas with access limits and explicit bridges to domain-reference novelty.
english_terms: memorization n-gram overlap attribution authenticity data copying creativity index

title: Fairness differential validity and creator-group bias in novelty judgments
question: Do novelty measures and LLM judges show differential validity, calibration or error across creator groups, languages and varieties, institutions and eras, and how should screening uses be audited?
required_adverse_case: Group differences in true novelty versus measurement bias; proxy variables; small-group estimates; conflicting fairness definitions. Do not assume latent true novelty is known; model criterion uncertainty, exposure and differential error before interpreting group gaps.
deliverable: Fairness audit protocol and reporting template bound to each protocol card's screening use.
english_terms: fairness bias novelty evaluation non-native English calibration disparate impact

title: Derivative works adaptations remixes translations and sequels
question: How is novelty measured when the object is a transformation of a named antecedent, and how do these measures relate to corpus-relative novelty?
required_adverse_case: Fidelity, quality and legal status are not transformation novelty; antecedent misidentification; chains of derivation. A named antecedent can be one of several sources; retain multiple and uncertain ancestry. Transformation distance alone need not capture corpus-relative or audience-relative novelty.
deliverable: Source-relative novelty protocol with antecedent identification requirements and cross-references to L14, L16, L25 and L29.
english_terms: adaptation remake cover remix sequel transformative derivative work novelty

title: Health clinical and biomedical practice innovation
required_subareas: public health and health service interventions
distinguish official administrative categories, substantive novelty constructs, approval status and clinical or commercial outcomes
question: How is novelty measured for drugs, devices, procedures, clinical practices and health interventions, and how do regulatory designations relate to research measures?
required_adverse_case: Approval, efficacy and safety are not novelty; first-in-class depends on classification systems; measurement here authorizes no clinical guidance. FDA novel-drug listings, NME/NCE classifications, first-in-class assessments and Breakthrough designations are distinct categories; do not treat them as interchangeable novelty scores.
deliverable: Health-domain measure atlas and protocol card with regulatory-definition mapping; no experimental or clinical content. Published experimental or clinical validation may be reviewed as evidence; no new experimentation, treatment advice or clinical execution is included.
english_terms: drug novelty first-in-class me-too medical device innovation clinical practice innovation

title: Game mechanics play and formally enumerable move spaces
question: How is novelty measured for mechanics, levels, moves and strategies against explicit recorded reference sets or formally specified spaces, and what transfers to open-ended domains?
required_adverse_case: Enumerable spaces inflate first-occurrence counts; engine evaluation is quality not novelty; database completeness varies by era. Formal enumerability does not establish observed completeness. Pin database versions, dates, coverage and unrecorded play; separate move, position and sequence novelty. Sports tactics and open-ended strategies need not form closed spaces.
deliverable: Bounded-reference novelty exemplar for L02, with a database coverage audit, and a mechanics-novelty protocol card. A closed universe may be claimed only for the explicitly defined corpus or demonstrably enumerated task.
english_terms: theoretical novelty chess opening database game mechanics expressive range procedural content novelty

title: Social media memes and platform content
question: How is content novelty measured on social platforms, how does it differ from virality, engagement and trend adoption, and how do recommendation systems shape the reference pool?
required_adverse_case: Virality, engagement, timeliness and platform original labels are not novelty; template reuse; bot and AI content in the reference pool.
deliverable: Platform-content novelty map with separated virality and engagement constructs.
english_terms: social media novelty meme virality collective attention originality platform
